fingerprint.fps: variable, 30 nominal; 18456 video frames in 1039.57 s

interventions.what: Bandicam window capture of the Isle Wars Pro game window; the owner played one game from the options screen to the end screen (17:20 recording). The video file is the only output. No scripted clicks. Counters, seats and screens were read from pixels by region comparison, with no OCR pass.

start_state.restore: Owner launched a new game on the unregistered Pro build from the options screen (seat 1 human, three computer seats, middle strength). Pro has no save file (C-SET-05), so no state was restored. The recording starts before the options screen; the opening deal is the first board.

args: probe: 1039.57 s, 18456 video frames, variable frame rate (nominal 30), 1920x1080 H.264, AAC 48 kHz stereo, 119613032 bytes
ffmpeg 8.0.1; the panel regions were read frame by frame from the container timestamps; offsets are mm:ss.mmm video offsets
